g.title: data-flow
g.text: Enumerate with indexer · re-read authoritative state over RPC · build plan · simulate · execute

g.title: cluster_verify
g.text: Never build a transaction from indexer data alone

g.title: cluster_plan
g.text: Deterministic - same state always produces same ordered plan

g.title: cluster_exec
g.text: One step at a time · sign · submit · confirm · advance

g.title: enum
g.text: Trustlines · offers · data entries · pool shares · signers · sponsorships

g.title: reread
g.text: Authoritative amounts · archived entry detection · sequence numbers

g.title: reconcile
g.text: Mismatch -> surface blocker instead of building an incomplete plan

g.title: plan
g.text: Signers -> Data -> Balances -> Offers -> Pools -> DeFi -> Convert -> Trustlines -> Merge

g.title: block
g.text: Sponsoring other accounts · AUTH_IMMUTABLE · missing route
Explained in plain language - never silently skipped

g.title: sim
g.text: Computes footprint · authorization entries · resource fee for every InvokeHostFunction

g.title: sign
g.text: Wallet adapter or in-memory secret key
User reviews XDR + confirms irreversibility before each step

g.title: submit
g.text: Client submits directly - never routed through the backend

g.title: poll
g.text: Exponential backoff · lost-response recovery · marks step confirmed
